Package com.recruitment.model

Class Job

java.lang.Object
com.recruitment.model.Job
public class Job extends Object
Domain model for a teaching-assistant or invigilation vacancy posted by a module organiser.

Tracks posting metadata, required skills, capacity (maxPositions / filledPositions), and lifecycle Job.Status. Persisted via jobs.json.

    • Job

      public Job()
      Creates a job with default Job.Status.OPEN, zero filled positions, and an empty required-skills list.

    • Job

      public Job(String id, String title, String description, String postedBy, Job.JobType jobType, int maxPositions)
      Creates a job with the given core fields and default open status.
      Parameters:
      id - unique job identifier
      title - short vacancy title
      description - full role description
      postedBy - user id of the module organiser who created the posting
      jobType - category of work
      maxPositions - maximum number of hires for this posting
